room russia (order 517) done: 13 second-order themes placed in existing kinds (30 placements; 17 rule 0 lines; no bag). The national sub in English and Russian, whose flag was lost at h37.6 and remade small and perfect by h65.5, with talk moved to r/Russiaclan: April 1 asked of the moderators beside off-topic joking (T3-017, T3-023), the bot's NP-link rule T3-063, calls to build and defend the Russian, USSR and heart flags (T3-002, T3-005, T3-065), coordinates, a script and a letter-number code against Dutch readers (T3-070, T3-028, T3-116), turf with the Czechs, the American and Slovak flags, proposals to turn the transgender flag Russian and Ukraine's flag Soviet (T3-061, T3-068, T3-045; the taunts and geopolitical threats in c0090, c0091, c0095 and c0110 are not named in the note, left for B1d), too few and zero coordination (T3-136, T3-049), the lost flag and a move to a heart (T3-022, T3-073), help asked by Armenian and Serbian brothers and traded with Indians (T3-084, T3-078, T3-151), borders and the Kalmar Union's peace (T3-010, T3-149, T3-024), whether the contest matters (T3-037, T3-016), a gym check-in T3-003, pushing place posts out (T3-075, T3-063), the flags' fate and taunts with the Dutch (T3-073, T3-009, T3-050). Episodes: joined E645 (the flag beside Serbia's), E646 (the alliance heart), E647 (the Leafs' neighbourhood); new E845 czech (the border and the non-encroachment offer, two members in both), E846 cirkeltrek, thenetherlands and czech (one Armenian member's plea in four rooms within an hour), E847 cirkeltrek, malaysia and thenetherlands (MH17 on a Russian flag taken by the Dutch), E848 Russiaclan (the flag effort carried into the new sub). One-sided: europe (a USSR-coloured attack, the Slovak flag), ukraine (Russia invading again, h62.9), greenlattice (latticing a Russian flag for Boba Fett space), norge and ainbowroad (a Russian heart for the St Petersburg attack, h69.8 to h70.8), the Kalmar ship in denmark and norge, transgender and osugame hold nothing on this room's proposals. Leads: india, Slovakia, armenia, israel, sweden (unread). Stretch 489 to 517 ends here

A Minecraft YouTuber's sub whose small orange Etho face sat beside the Mindcrack faces under FTL: building the face, calling hands in and a Mojang logo's makers asking help (T3-038, T3-002, T3-084), revising the design, keeping the border black against FTL and moving the face (T3-004, T3-055, T3-020; refusing expansion sits in one concept), celebrating the small mark T3-009, a fake Etho episode for April Fools and its reception T3-001, coordinates and the face destroyed by the Netherlands (T3-070, T3-029), jokes about the orange tan and a swastika gone from Doc (T3-031, T3-073), calls to save it and for scripts (T3-005, T3-028), taking up r/Mindcrack's plan T3-137, backups and another move T3-022, Discord warnings relayed T3-152.
